_note: Update notes shown under What's new. Newest first. When a game gets an update, add an entry at the top: date (YYYY-MM-DD), a short title and plain-English items. Then run tools/sync.py and tools/publish.py. Days with no entry here fall back to the game's GitHub commit messages.

overdrive.title: Online works from the launcher
items: Online races now find the Ruff Dogs server when you play from the Ruff Dogs Launcher.
Launcher players show up as PC players.

overdrive.title: Look around while you race
items: Move the mouse to look around your car while racing. The camera eases back behind you after a moment.
The mouse pointer hides during races. Press Esc to pause.
Smoother sound on slower PCs.

overdrive.title: Faster start and tunnel fix
items: The intro no longer freezes on PC: the game gets its graphics ready before the video plays.
Fixed tunnel entrances that had a wall sticking into the road.
Less choppy sound on laptops.

overdrive.title: Graphics settings and online lookup
items: New GRAPHICS setting (High, Medium, Low). It picks the right one for your PC by itself.
Press F3 to see your frame rate.
The game finds the online server by itself.

overdrive.title: Smoother roads
items: Fixed black puddles that looked like holes in the road.
Fixed black spots where the ground poked through the road.

ghost-hunters-tv.title: Online works from the launcher
items: Hosting and joining shows now works when you play from the Ruff Dogs Launcher.

ghost-hunters-tv.title: Windows version and online fix
items: Ghost Hunters TV now has its own Windows .exe with a start screen.
Online rooms connect more reliably.

ghost-hunters-tv.title: First release
items: One friend films, the rest host, and one friend can be the ghost.
Four ghosts to catch on camera: Edith, Poltergeist Pete, Sir Clanksalot and Gloop.
Silly crew with big noses and wobbly heads.

brutalist-vr.title: New weapons and grabbing enemies
items: New weapons: the zweihander, scimitar, naginata, mace, pitchfork and an autocannon.
Enemies can grab your hand. Shake it free or punch your way out.
Rebuilt hands with real fingers.
Hub stalls now page with arrows.

brutalist-vr.title: Hub, career and new maps
items: A market hall hub with four weapon stalls, a tailor and a jobs board.
Weapon walls on every map, plus 13 jobs to earn cash.
New maps: alley, rooftops, yard, tenement, depot, metro, chapel and downtown.
Fixed VR walking going the wrong way after you turn.

infiltrate.title: Missions and operators
items: Three missions: BLACK SITE, HARBOR and THE VILLA.
Pick an operator: SPECTRE, TORCH or WRAITH.
Gadgets: drone, breach charges, flashbangs and a heartbeat sensor.
Security cameras and walls you can shoot through.

halloweenvr.title: The Shape update
items: Evil Within: stalk people who haven't noticed you to grow stronger in three tiers. Tier III makes you fast and unstoppable for fifty seconds.
Stand still to hear frightened heartbeats through the walls.
Friends fight back: someone who sees you grab a friend will rush in and pull them free.
Dr. Loomis now actually hunts you with his revolver.
New look: glowing streetlights with light shafts, a damp street, film grain and bloom on PC, drifting dust, falling leaves and trees in the wind.
Haddonfield dressed for Halloween: carved jack-o'-lanterns, bushy hedges, telephone poles and wires, a scarecrow, hay bales, lawn tombstones, hydrants and the Lampkin Lane street sign.

halloweenvr.title: Haddonfield update
items: Real jointed fingers, and both hands now match your controllers.
You start outside on the lawn across from the Myers house.
A simple arrow shows you where to go next.

granny-vr.title: First release
items: Escape Granny's house in VR or on PC.

gore-lab.title: New sounds and better faces
items: Realistic weapon, impact and punch sounds.
More realistic dummies with sculpted noses.
New explosions.
Fixed the choke grab on necks.

jasons-revenge.title: Prettier skies
items: A painted tree line on the horizon.
Clouds that fade in and out smoothly.
Flatter far hills.

jasons-revenge.title: Play as a counselor
items: New counselor mode: hide from Jason, find items and escape.
Six areas with lit, furnished cabins. Pick one on the title screen.
Smarter, scarier Jason.
A more realistic forest and moonlight.

manhuntvr.title: Story scenes and Executions menu
items: Fourteen story cutscenes with voice acting between levels.
New Executions menu: try every weapon on a demo stage.
New stone and concrete textures for Born Again.
Fixed the news anchor having no sound in VR.

asylumvr.title: New title music
items: New title themes and menu sounds.
Install it as an app on your Quest.

asylumvr.title: Testing Site
items: A new Testing Site area with its own logo and theme.
Tape 4: the chained door opens with the bolt cutters.
VR captions now fit on screen.

postal2-vr.title: Voices and fixes
items: Hundreds of new voice lines.
Fixed the game not loading online.

postal2-vr.title: First release
items: Play on a flat screen or in VR.
